dataList.dlg: It is best not to let time flow meaninglessly. This place will soon be filled with clamor and suffering, but we need not delay in accepting the inevitable.
I do not wish to see you suffer for the death of your employees. Set your mind at ease, and let us begin our work. We will not ever lose anyone, as long as the cycle repeats.
The situation has turned rather unfavorable. That's okay. We will try a different approach next time.
Attempt everything you have wished to try. Once you have tested all the possibilities, simply begin anew.
So, even those things can be brought to a halt. To a standstill.
It appears the employee's state is unstable.
You are as capable as ever. I shall make a record of that achievement.
New employees shall come and replace the deceased ones. It is simply another notch in a continuing cycle—there is no need for you to suffer so harshly over it.
Why not just stop here? Surely there is no true need for us to change.
So you are following the formula of success. If only we could follow that same formula indefinitely.
... You would still move onward, in spite of everything?

Perhaps it is inevitable that we will reach the final page eventually, even with the flow of time stretched to infinity.
Will you record the final entry?
According to the records, death will follow the trails of that action. Please be careful.
You should be more than capable of analyzing this with the eyes of rationality and arriving at a conclusion. Please proceed. I shall record the outcome.
That action accords with the records.
Do you mean to act contrary to the records?
A prudent, rational judgment.
... Excessive prudence morphs into a knife that cuts its wielder.
Are they savoring their freedom beyond the walls of the containment unit? They have grown all the more unruly than usual.
The deterrence is functioning as intended. I shall account for this in the records and performance appraisal.
They look quite beside themselves with joy. Perhaps those who received my offer letters once wore that same expression.
That employee is wandering about, aimlessly searching for the sanity which they have lost.
Something spills forth through the crack you've made.
The destructive current of change has eventually caught up to it. Perhaps this is more to your liking, given your pursuit of change.
I must say, your intent here eludes me. What more must you sacrifice? What is it that you're trying to achieve here?
Can you not see when it is time to stop? Now seems to be the most apt. Please stop and stay here with me, in this eternal moment.
This display of competence is quite familiar. It's become an indelible memory to me.

Perhaps this outcome was a given; after all, it was you who assigned the exact task, which was then carried out by an employee you hand-picked. But the guarantee of success does not mean that a job well done should go without commendation. Well done.
Remarkable. I will make a note of this employee's particulars in their records, in the likely event that you might wish to select them again.
Savor the fruits of your choices and sacrifices. After all that time spent enduring loss... are you satisfied with the things you have achieved?

There's no need to cling to lost causes. Now then, let's try again next time. With me.
I'm not sure if you recall, but I've always been on your side.

I've been expecting you. I knew you would come soon, even as I waited here—where everything has sunk into stillness.
You may call me Hokma. I am responsible for recording and controlling everything that occurs.
